unlisted_practices: Zero-shot LLM classification to filter non-session transcripts from behavioral health conversation datasets, validated against expert annotation
Using LLM perplexity as a measure of transcript noise and comprehensibility
Statistical and structural feature extraction to detect outlier transcripts in conversational datasets
Manual mapping of transcription errors, including speaker diarization problems, before research use
Selecting data-processing tools that preserve anonymity and minimize breach risk

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based and statistical preprocessing pipeline for filtering out non-session noise from behavioral health transcripts for research utility, but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail in a clinical workflow.
